newsitem.title: UK: Syria's November Souedie crude price cut - trade.
newsitem.headline: Syria's November Souedie crude price cut - trade.

text.p: Syria's state oil company Sytrol has cut the November price of its heavy Souedie crude by 90 cents to Dated Brent -$3.90 per barrel, contract holders said on Tuesday.
The Syrian Light price for November lifting was already raised by 25 cents to Dated Brent -5 cents, they added.
A contract holder said bitumen-rich Souedie's sharp price fall was because the bitumen season was finished in Europe and the crude was now being valued according to traditional refining valuation.
